# A29′ — Return or Extraction

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

The FROM→TO row *humans in charge → omnidirectional delegation* (PDF p. 56) makes return the ethic of the whole table. When delegation runs in every direction — person to agent, agent to agent, institution to ensemble — its pathology is not error but **disappearance**: the answer looks instantaneous, the product self-contained, the agent autonomous, and the labour that produced them goes unattributed. [Power and delegated labour](../A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) require a circuit — the power that receives a product must remain answerable to the labour and world through which it arrived — through a full return: resistance, error, cost, dissent and unforeseen possibility must be able to change the governing model, measure, instruction, institution or purpose. The projected crossover makes that circuit consequential across the proposed hybrid society.

The structural pair is **Contribution and Return**. A contribution enters a shared field under attribution and revisable terms; return carries consequence back to the office capable of altering the next act.

**Extraction is delegation without return.** Commands, labour, data and consequences flow down or outward while nothing capable of changing the commission flows back. The signature is inspectable in any stack: identify the contribution, follow its consequence, and ask what has write-access to the purpose, criterion or permission under which the work was commissioned.

## #1

The crossover makes disappearance exact. Bratton's [slower-abstraction-layer passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q012) holds that humans "as a whole no longer provide most of the system's problem-solving capacity" and instead "act as a slower abstraction layer guiding a much larger field of artificial cognition"; its [companion](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q013) names the rebalancing: "normatively central but computationally secondary." Both belong to the brief’s proposed scenario, marked "obviously not evenly distributed" by the brief itself. In the circuit of contribution and return, at a projected cognitive-labour crossover, attribution can fail where a fluent interface withholds the sources, performers and transformations which made its result possible. The [one-sided translation](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q008) sharpens the mechanism — it has proven far easier to make machines behave as if they knew how humans think than to teach humans how computers think — so the received answer need not make its production intelligible. That omission remains a condition to investigate and repair. A system which already provides an adequate route to the relevant source, performer and judging office has not failed merely by being fluent.

"Who performed this work?" asks [how an omitted contribution enters the account](A10-prime-Uncounted-Enters-the-Account.md): the accounting gets precise — planning, delegation, forecasting become exact — while what the counted presences are stays unsettled. The unattributed remains consequential work. A [[section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md#1|Working Absence]] names what the present account omitted: a performer, source, cost or transformation whose office the inquiry can recover. It does not turn that omission into the native unobjectifiable knower or make every technical account necessarily incomplete in the same practical respect.

## #2

Extraction is a relation, not a synonym for delegation or automation. Delegation concerns entrusted capacity and answerability; automation concerns how an operation is executed; exchange organises reciprocal transfer under terms; gift can relinquish without requiring equivalent return; extraction names a taking whose relation to the sustaining field, affected parties and returned value must be examined. Omnidirectional delegation is therefore not per se extraction. It becomes extraction when the return-leg is severed — when evidence of what was done, effects on those affected, and revision or refusal where owed have no route back to any office that can act on them.

The human office the crossover names — value-setting, oversight, long-horizon judgment — is real only under return. An oversight with no upward channel is ornamental: [a proposed distinction must justify an inspectable consequence](A33-prime-Parity.md). Work and Play can then invert: the public ledger can accurately record visible outputs while the consequential routing decisions stay in a protected interior — an account that is accurate and still hides its governing play. The brief's relay-economy worry about simulations inviting "value generation, decay, or deception" (PDF p. 57, Q9) is the same audit question at the simulation boundary.

## #3

The positive relation is [[section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md#3|Attributable Difference]] that comes back. Evidence of what was done; effects on those affected; revision or refusal where owed. For machine-to-machine delegations without a person inspecting every act, return has an architectural route: traces reach the office which can judge a corrected answer or task, while evaluations let encountered evidence challenge their measures. Recommissioning can be a typed operation initiated within the system: its scoped authority determines which terms it can revise itself and which it must return to its commissioner. The reachable governing offices are model, measure, instruction, institution and purpose. A fitting rule can remain while an attribution, answer or model is corrected; a failed rule must reach its capable authority. An examined condition can also be retained with reasons. The next delegated act inherits the judgment and source through the actual route.

Dissent belongs to the source relation. The trust-revision fork — an account can support reliance while admitting provisionality, or export its unresolved distrust onto a scapegoat — makes attribution consequential at social scale. An account can conceal the conditions of its failure and displace the unresolved distrust onto a participant whose objection has no return route. Recovering who did the work and who can answer exposes that protected-account operation; practical omission alone does not establish that scapegoating has occurred. [Power and delegated labour](../concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour.md) preserve the dependency within an achieved capacity; [trust under formal limit](../concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) makes reliance conditional upon a scoped undertaking which can be challenged or withdrawn.

## #4

The affected reach beyond the user. Someone outside the intended audience may still bear the cost, and distance from the screen does not remove them from the relation: the dataset's sources, the annotation and maintenance labour, the energy and material substrate. The convenience of the immediate user cannot erase the labour or damage displaced beyond their view. [Commons without monopoly](../concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly.md) retain a field-level constraint — no recipient of the commons' labour acquires ownership of its source by receiving products. And where learning accrues, the [ensemble passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q039) locates it precisely: "The unit that learns is the ensemble, not the agent, and what it learns accrues to the commons between them, not to any single one" — so the governance question is exactly who the return reaches. The provenance face of that question belongs to [The Commons Behind the System](A35-prime-Commons-Behind-the-System.md); the circuit follows those sources through the consequence and into a subsequent commission.

## #5→0

The circuit closes where it opened: return reaches the office able to change the next action. Read as a whole, the FROM→TO table is a delegation table — every row entrusts something — and its rows succeed as covenant ([Covenant Architecture](A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md)) only insofar as each row's difference returns. The crossover's proper form is not humans signing what they cannot see, but the abstraction layer that receives, judges and re-commissions: the slower layer whose slowness is the return-leg's dwell time.

[Delegated labour returns through power](../A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) when the completed work, cost and objection reach an office able to alter its next use. [Entrustment](AC.md) keeps that office answerable to the purpose and lives for which the work was commissioned. Across omnidirectional delegation, this enacted return distinguishes a covenant from extraction.
